result.summary: The page layout mostly looks fine; one minor issue found with restaurant name truncation in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant name appears truncated ('Trattoria Piccol') within its visible card portion, though this may be due to the card being partially cut off at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses ellipsis styling consistently if the card is fully visible, or verify this is only due to the intentional horizontal scroll clipping.
